shortDescription: Bring your desktop to life with live wallpapers, interactive effects, creative tools and local AI.
description:
Virtual Paper is a free, open-source live wallpaper app for Windows. Make your desktop your own with images, videos, animated images and interactive Web wallpapers, or get started with the included collection.

Keep your wallpapers organized with favorites, tags, search and filters. Choose a different wallpaper for each display, duplicate one across screens or span it across your desktop.

Add parallax and atmosphere effects, then save your favorite combinations as reusable presets. Create image wallpapers with layers and drawing tools, or build interactive wallpapers in the Web editor with live preview.

Use local AI tools to transform image styles, enhance images and fit them to your screen. Switch instantly between ten interface languages and get started without an account.
features: Image, video, animated-image and interactive Web wallpapers
Included wallpapers, favorites, tags, search and filters
Per-display, duplicated and extended wallpaper layouts
Parallax, atmosphere effects and reusable effect presets
Layered image editor and Web editor with live preview
Local AI style transfer, image enhancement and screen fitting
Ten interface languages with live language switching
